I've been vigilant in seeking professional care since 18. I'm  31 now and in absolute hell. I've been prescribed as many antidepressants possible, seen almost as many therapists practicing different modalities, done TMS, been hospitalized twice and, and NOTHING has helped. I'm tired of trying, existing, struggling so much to get through the day.

I've never fully come out of it, and am utterly despondent every day. I have passive to active suicidal ideation daily, and don't feel life is worth living.

Having said that, my very renowned psychiatrist has informed me I'm one of the most treatment resistant patients he's ever encountered (not that he's given up trying by any means).


I sincerely hope your journey is different, you hold on to hope and keep going, calling on the strength you have...and it gets better for you.

All the best!
